title: Erlang topic pub/sub registry
context: Topic pub/sub server. subscribe/1 registers the calling process for a topic, and subscribing twice must not cause duplicate deliveries. publish/2 sends {msg, Topic, Payload} only to live subscribers of that topic. Subscribers that exit for any reason must be removed automatically; subscriber processes are long-lived and subscribe and unsubscribe often.
code: {noreply, maps:map(fun(_T, Pids) -> lists:delete(Pid, Pids) end, Subs)}.

expected.why: a new monitor is created on every subscribe and never removed on unsubscribe, so monitors pile up for long-lived subscribers
a second subscribe adds the pid again, so the subscriber receives every message twice
the message goes to the subscribers of every topic, not only those of Topic
only normal exits are matched, so subscribers that crash are never removed (and other DOWN messages crash the server with function_clause)
